label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: la menorá la pura, sus lámparas, lámparas del arreglo, y todos sus utensilios y el aceite de la lumbrera,
spanish: el candelabro el puro, sus lámparas, lámparas del arreglo, y todos sus utensilios y el aceite de la lumbrera,
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated transliteration 'menorá' (h02039037002) with the Spanish common noun 'candelabro'.
Changed the following adjective from feminine 'la pura' to masculine 'el puro' for grammatical agreement with the new masculine noun 'candelabro'.
readerNote: Chose 'candelabro' (masculine) as the Spanish common noun for the lampstand and adjusted the adjective to masculine 'puro' to agree; Hebrew's feminine grammatical gender carries no separate meaning here.
